title: Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, expects to play against Texans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, expects to play against Texans
sources.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow will be on this week's injury report, but he doesn't expect to be at risk of missing Sunday's game against the Texans.
